**ERR-EDI-0140** is a Sales Order module error with the message "Unknown Buyer Item Code", raised by inbound EDI order translation service `edi_ord_in` under interface specification INT-EDI-001 [1][2][3]. 

It occurs during inbound EDI order processing when an incoming line item contains a buyer product code that cannot be resolved via the customer cross-reference table to an internal Northbridge finished bicycle or frame part [1][2]. INT-EDI-001 halts processing and rejects the order/batch until the translation is configured [1][3]. (Manual MAN-SAL-72 also defines it more broadly as a syntax or mapping error from corrupted records, invalid tags, or missing customer trade parameters [2].)

To resolve it, sales staff must inspect the customer mapping table, add the missing item translation, and reprocess the pending order [1].
